source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: SPX with NOPE ETF Launch (29MAY24 p3 top)
# =============================================================================
# The NOPE bearish ETF launched ~Oct 2022, approximately three weeks before
# stocks bottomed. When a financial product is launched to monetize a trend,
# it often signals trend exhaustion. SPX went from ~3,600 to ~5,300.
# Reference price at NOPE launch: ~3,650 (Oct 2022 bottom area)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
idx = index()

# Moving averages for trend context
ma50 = ma(period=50)(close)
ma200 = ma(period=200)(close)

xy_lines(
    title='SPX Late 2021 to Now: Did the Bearish ETF Mark the Bottom?',
    category='Product Launch Contrarian',
    y_axis_label='SPY Price (USD)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SPY Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='50d MA', color=Color.Sky, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='200d MA', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=360.0, title='NOPE Bearish ETF Launches (~Oct 2022)', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=idx, y_values=(close, ma50, ma200))
